scope: Booleans / values the TS glue (packages/pca/src/verified-decision.ts and the call sites in pcactn.ts, capability.ts, threshold.ts, replay.ts, server/verify.ts) computes from cryptographic primitives and hands to the Dafny-verified core. Each entry states what the value MUST mean so it can be mirrored as a Dafny precondition / axiom. 'checkedBy' names the contract-checking monitor (packages/pca-verified-core/test/diverse/glue) that recomputes it independently on every call made while the conformance corpus + fuzz run; 'unchecked' means no independent recompute exists yet.

primitiveAssumptions.meaning: sha256(x) is the FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 of the byte string x (collision/second-preimage resistance assumed).
primitiveAssumptions.checkedBy: monitor hash.sha256 (node:crypto OpenSSL) + primitives harness (Wycheproof/NIST ACVP, 4 independent impls)

primitiveAssumptions.meaning: sha384(x) is the FIPS 180-4 SHA-384 of x.

keys.verify(pk,msg,sig) is TRUE iff (a) len(pk)=32, len(sig)=64; (b) S=LE(sig[32..64]) < L (group order); (c) the encodings of A=pk and R=sig[0..32] are canonical (y < 2^255-19, and not x=0 with sign bit 1) and decode to curve points; (d) neither A nor R has small order ([8]P != identity); (e) A and R are torsion-free ([L]P = identity); (f) the cofactorless RFC 8032 equation [S]B = R + [k]A holds with k = SHA-512(R||A||msg) mod L. Equivalently: RFC 8032 section 5.1.7 strict verification restricted to the prime-order subgroup. NOTE noble's own zip215:false option alone is COFACTORED (accepts mixed-order A/R that RFC verifiers reject); pca's composite closes this with the isSmallOrder/isTorsionFree checks.
primitiveAssumptions.checkedBy: monitor ed25519.verify (independent BigInt curve model + OpenSSL equation) + primitives harness (10 voters)

primitiveAssumptions.meaning: mlDsa65Verify / mlDsa87Verify(pk,msg,sig) is TRUE iff FIPS 204 ML-DSA.Verify (pure, empty context) accepts; wrong lengths (pk 1952/2592, sig 3309/4627) are FALSE.
primitiveAssumptions.checkedBy: monitor suite.* (node:crypto OpenSSL 3.5) + primitives harness (noble, OpenSSL, fips204 crate)

primitiveAssumptions.meaning: slhDsa128fVerify / slhDsa256sVerify(pk,msg,sig) is TRUE iff FIPS 205 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f / -256s Verify (pure, empty context) accepts; wrong lengths (pk 32/64, sig 17088/29792) are FALSE.
primitiveAssumptions.checkedBy: monitor suite.* + primitives harness (noble, OpenSSL, slh-dsa crate)

contract.name: decodeB64uStrict(s,len) != null
contract.meaning: s is a string over [A-Za-z0-9_-], length mod 4 != 1, re-encoding the decoded bytes yields exactly s (no non-zero trailing bits, no padding), and if len is given the decoded length is len.
contract.usedBy: verifyB64u, *VerifyB64u, threshold key parse, sigs/keys everywhere

contract.name: hashCanonical(v) string equality
contract.meaning: hashCanonical(v) = b64url_nopad(H(UTF8(canonicalizeStrict(v)))) where canonicalizeStrict is: object keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes, no whitespace, strings JSON-escaped, safe-integer numbers or plain-decimal numbers with <=15 significant digits, no -0, no lone surrogates, depth <= 32, plain objects only, no cycles; any violation THROWS. Two values are 'caveat-equal' / 'hash-equal' iff these strings are equal (collision-free assumption).
contract.usedBy: capability.ts capHash, ceq in decideChain (hashCanonical(child)===hashCanonical(parent)), parentLinkOk, root==grant, body_digest comparison, params_digest, plan leaves

contract.name: capChainStatus rootIsGrant = capHash(chain[0]) === capHash(opts.grant)
contract.meaning: the first chain element is byte-identical (canonical form) to the grant the verifier holds.
contract.checkedBy: G-CANON (string equality of two checked hashes)

contract.name: ChainHop.parentLinkOk
contract.meaning: hop.parent (a string) === capHash(previous hop) i.e. the hash of the entire previous capability including its signature.

contract.name: ChainHop.issuerIsParentHolder
contract.meaning: hop.issuer === previous hop.holder (string equality, no key decoding).

contract.name: ceq(child caveat, parent caveat)
contract.meaning: hashCanonical(child) === hashCanonical(parent): caveats are equal iff their strict canonical forms are equal (so key order is irrelevant, numeric spelling is not).

contract.name: ChainHop.sig (Res ok)
contract.meaning: OK iff: suite known; the body digest recomputed as hashCanonical(signableBody) equals hop.body_digest AND hop.id; and verifyWithSuite(alg, {edPub: signer, pq: pinned PQ key}, sigMessage(body_digest), {sig, pq_sig}) is true where signer = root.issuer for hop 0 else parent.holder, sigMessage = UTF8(CAP_DOMAIN)||bytes(body_digest).

contract.name: verifyWithSuite(alg, keys, msg, {sig, pq_sig})
contract.meaning: false for unknown alg or a PQ key that is not a minted PinnedPqKey. ed25519: sig is a string and keys.edPub a string and P-ED25519-STRICT(edPub, msg, sig) after strict b64u decode (32/64 bytes). ml-dsa-65/87, slh-dsa-sha2-128f/256s (pure PQ): P-MLDSA/P-SLHDSA over msg with pq key bytes and sig bytes strictly b64u-decoded to the exact lengths. hybrid-ed25519-X: ed25519 component AND PQ component (pq_sig) both over the SAME msg. hybrid-nested-ed25519-ml-dsa-65: ed25519 over msg AND ML-DSA-65 over msg||sig_ed25519_bytes. fn-dsa-* / less-cat1: out of scope of the monitor (backends via wasm).
contract.computedAt: packages/pca/src/pq.ts verifyWithSuite (called from capability.ts checkSig, threshold.ts sigOk)
contract.checkedBy: monitor suite (reference.ts suiteRef; independent decoders, node:crypto OpenSSL PQ, BigInt-model Ed25519)

contract.name: leafDecision.sigOk = verifyLeafSuite({alg, holder, pq, message, sig, pqSig})
contract.meaning: = verifyWithSuite(alg, {edPub: holder, pq}, message, {sig, pq_sig}) where message = thresholdMessage(pcactn) (canonical signed body).
contract.computedAt: pq.ts verifyLeafSuite; pcactn.ts step 3; threshold.ts baseline leafSigOk

contract.name: ThresholdShare.sigOk
contract.meaning: typeof share.sig is string AND verifyWithSuite(share.alg, {edPub: share.publicKey, pq: key pinned from the signer-set's registered pq_pk}, shareMessage(role, message, signerSet, t, alg), {sig, pq_sig}).

contract.name: Signer.keyOk
contract.meaning: decodeB64uStrict(publicKey, 32) != null (a canonical 32-byte b64url string; NOT a validity check of the point).

contract.name: pqBinding matches arg
contract.meaning: typeof pq_pk === 'string' AND holderPqCommitment(pq_pk) === committed (hash equality of the PQ key under the commitment hash); only evaluated when the suite needs a PQ key, allowUnbound is false and a commitment exists.

contract.name: planDecision matches arg
contract.meaning: merkleRoot(plan.map(planNodeLeaf)) === p.plan.root (SHA-256 Merkle; leaves are hashCanonical-based).
contract.checkedBy: P-SHA256 only (merkle structure covered by the conformance corpus 'merkle' primitives, not independently recomputed)

contract.name: verifyInclusion(plan.root, proof, leaf)
contract.meaning: folding the sibling path from leaf with the domain-separated SHA-256 node hash yields plan.root.
contract.checkedBy: unchecked (Merkle fold not independently recomputed; SHA-256 itself is)

contract.name: ReplayFacts.*
contract.meaning: pure shape predicates over the PCActn and verifier options: nowOk=Number.isSafeInteger(now); verifierAudOk = non-empty string <=MAX_AUD_LEN UTF-8 bytes; audMatches = string equality; iatOk/expOk = non-negative safe integers; leafOk = leaf holder and grant_ref are strings; componentsOk = every key component non-empty, no lone surrogate, <=MAX_REPLAY_COMPONENT_LEN bytes; counterOk non-negative safe integer; nonceOk = non-empty well-formed string <=128 UTF-8 bytes. No cryptographic primitive involved.
contract.checkedBy: unchecked (no primitive; verified by the differential tests against the frozen legacy implementation)

contract.name: consumed / advanced
contract.meaning: consumed = store.consumeOnce(key, retainUntil, now) returned true exactly when the key was absent or expired (atomic test-and-set); advanced = counters.advance(stream, counter) returned true exactly when counter > last accepted (atomic compare-and-set). These are environment assumptions about the replay store, not computed by the glue.

contract.name: hookStatus(enforced, ok)
contract.meaning: enforced = hook returned {enforced:true}; ok = hook returned ok:true; hooks (attestation, threshold, revocation, zk) are caller-supplied trusted components whose truth is NOT re-derived.

contract.name: hookTInt(h)
contract.meaning: undefined for non-number or NaN; +/-MAX_SAFE_INTEGER for +/-Infinity (clamped); floor(h) otherwise; so for integer t, h >= t iff hookTInt(h) >= t.
contract.checkedBy: test/finding-clock.test.ts-style differential in the verified-core suite; not part of this monitor
